assumptions: Low and medium volume equated to small HACCP plants in RTI2015; high volume to large.
260 respondent operating days; federal daily review implies365 days.

reconstruction_issues: Microbiology detailed activities200+13224+85524+14254=113202, while nearby prose113435 conflicts.
SOP review rows899340+582140+350100=1831580 responses, not1582620 total.
HACCP development prose971250 is reassessment total, while development table12500.
Federal weekly HACCP review6087*.25*52=79131 rather than100000; other workload denominators unstated.
Loaded respondent cost differs by70.32 from published hours*rate.
RTI2015 cited report returned403 through official links; underlying estimates not independently corroborated.
methods_worth_testing: Task/plant-size tables tie recurring recordkeeping to physical operations.
Reference empirical cost study with explicit mapping from study size classes.
Extensive documentation can expose errors without resolving them.
